routes.title: Great Wings, and the Light of Heaven

rows.en: ...Explain yourself, Luhran. Why did that weapon fail to deliver the power we expected?
Twin Lord uses Briest of the Fires' Plasma Bullet Magrash and...
rows.notes: First half of the weapon explanation; deliberate cutoff before row 2.

rows.en: Gallowin of the Waters' Beam Searcher, which collide in midair to destroy the target along with the space around it...
rows.notes: Continues row 1: the two attacks collide in midair and destroy target plus surrounding space.
uncertain: Beam Searcher is provisional pending centralized sourcing.

rows.en: But for it to unleash its full power...
rows.notes: Deliberate cutoff; row 4 supplies the synchronization requirement.

rows.en: The Shi sisters' timing abilities must be synchronized.
Aen and Tau are twin sisters... What could prevent them from using Twin Lord?
Y-you should know the reason very well, Your Majesty...
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing wrapper and trailing indent.

rows.en: As their last sortie made clear, entrusting those two with recapturing Zeorymer of the Heavens would be...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished judgment, interrupted by Yuratei.

rows.en: ...I have an idea. Summon the Shi sisters here.
Tau... What was that about during today's training?
We did destroy the target in the end. Isn't that good enough, dear sister...?
rows.notes: Sister address retains Tau's polite but resentful edge.

rows.en: If either of us rushes ahead, that isn't teamwork. It puts one of us in danger.
You seem almost... eager to die.
You call it teamwork... But isn't my Gallowin just there to support your Briest?
I have no intention of being your shield, sister...!
Tau...!
...You look exactly alike, yet somehow you grew up with such different personalities.
Saiga! Don't you ever say that again!!
Heh...
rows.notes: Derisive breath/laugh.

rows.en: Saiga... I'd thank you to stop meddling in our affairs.
Very well. Her Majesty has summoned you both.
Her Majesty summoned us...?
rows.notes: Elliptical echo restores summoned action from preceding line. Meaning review: Restored the actual summoning action in the echo rather than leaving only the auxiliary.

rows.en: Shi-Aen, Shi-Tau... I shall now go to Japan in secret. You will accompany me as my guards.

rows.notes: Nonverbal surprise retained in both uses.
Nonverbal surprise retained in both uses.

rows.en: W-with all respect, Your Majesty... That is far too dangerous. That land is enemy territory to us.
I know. But I wish to see Zeorymer's pilot with my own eyes.
Heh... So that's it. It seems Her Majesty still cannot let go of her feelings for Taiha.
rows.notes: Yuratei female pronouns supported by glossary; Taiha attachment is Saiga's interpretation.

rows.en: B-but...!
Say no more, Luhran. I will go to Japan to learn what that man... Masaki Kihara, is plotting.
Then I intend to decide whether to recapture the Heavens... or destroy it.
rows.notes: The Heavens is source-short reference to Zeorymer of the Heavens.
Deliberate silence.

rows.en: So this isn't about avenging Taiha...
rows.notes: Taiha referent settled by row 27.

rows.en: Either way, it seems both outcomes work to my advantage...
rows.notes: Saiga sees either result as personally advantageous. Meaning review: Removed added I see; source questioning particle marks tentative self-assessment.

rows.en: ...I've also heard from GEAR's Chief Shibuya. You've been through a great deal, Captain Bright... Ruri.
rows.notes: Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: Not at all...
Thanks to your efforts, factories in various regions have begun full-scale mass production of Dragoons.
rows.notes: Meaning review: Removed unsupported country restriction from various locations.

rows.en: With that underway, the General Staff is planning a major counteroffensive against Giganos.
I'll give you the details once they're settled... For now, take up patrol duties in the Japan sector.
Until the preparations are complete... Is that right?
rows.notes: Ruri verifies duration of patrol assignment.

rows.en: Yes... Including those concerning the Martian Successors.
...Understood.
Commander, about your daughter...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished inquiry about commander's daughter.

rows.en: You needn't say any more, Colonel. Simply knowing my daughter is alive is enough.
Besides, we must deal with enemies other than the Martian Successors as well.
...Yes, sir.
Um... May I ask you something?
What is it, Ruri?
Could you choose a new name for our force?
rows.notes: Ruri asks Misumaru to choose; row 48 delegates the choice back to Ruri.

rows.en: The Nahel Argama and Nadesico team is a bit of a mouthful.
Indeed. Then, Ruri... You choose the name.
Huh? Me? I think we should ask everyone else's opinion too...
That would get out of hand. Let's settle it here.
Uh... All right.
Be sure to give the new force a serious name.
If it's a strange name, all sorts of enemies will have to say it... and even the dramatic moments will fall flat.
rows.notes: Meta joke: enemies speaking a silly player-entered name spoil dramatic scenes.

rows.en: That's true. Then...
Let's call it #部隊名.
rows.notes: Runtime placeholder preserved exactly.

rows.en: #部隊名, eh...? Captain Bright, what do you think?
rows.notes: Runtime placeholder preserved exactly. Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: I have no objections.
Then it's settled.
#部隊名?
rows.notes: Runtime placeholder preserved exactly.

rows.en: Yes, apparently that's our new force's name.
Tch. So they didn't ask us this time.
I was gonna name us 'Koji Kabuto and His Merry Friends' this time for sure...
rows.notes: Koji refers to an earlier naming attempt; kept distinct wording for Shinji's echo. Meaning review: Corrected 今度こそ: determination to succeed this time, not an additional attempt this time too. Coordinator applied worker4 original-source review: determination this time for sure and Shinji exact two-part echo; replaces awkward at-last wording. Meaning correction, no compression; initial draft retained.

rows.en: This time? This time for sure?
rows.notes: Ignored stray wrapper and trailing indent. Echo of both temporal phrases. Meaning review: Changed echo to match corrected this time / at last phrases in row 62. Coordinator applied worker4 original-source review: determination this time for sure and Shinji exact two-part echo; replaces awkward at-last wording. Meaning correction, no compression; initial draft retained.

rows.en: Oh, no, no... It's nothing.
What's this 'Merry Friends' nonsense? That's a real mouthful.
Then what name would you like, Asuka?
Do you want to hear it?
Just so I know.
rows.notes: Restored I would like to hear rather than a verbless fragment. Meaning review: Natural complete clause for the reference-only request; source action is hearing Asuka's idea.

rows.en: Then I'll tell you. Clean out your ears and listen closely!
'The Second Red of Effort and Guts, the Great Asuka Langley Soryu and Her Faithful Servants'!
rows.notes: Intentionally overblown proposed name; Effort and Guts are source literals, title remains provisional.
uncertain: Second Red is a source-literal proposed team title, pending centralized sourcing.

rows.en: W-what the heck is that?!
That's even more of a mouthful.
Shut up! It was obviously a joke! A joke!
Maybe she was actually serious...
rows.notes: She refers to Asuka, glossary-supported gender.

rows.en: By the way, Shinji, what would you call us?
M-me?
U-um... Maybe 'New Squadron Evangelion'?
rows.notes: Invented team name plays on Evangelion title; New Squadron preserves source words.

rows.en: That makes it sound like there are only EVAs.
Oh, right...
Besides, there's no way an idiot like Shinji could come up with a clever squad name!
rows.notes: Asuka attacks Shinji's squad-name suggestion; idiot retained.

rows.en: Y-you don't have to put it like that! I tried my best to think of one!
rows.notes: Shinji protests Asuka; stutter and effort restored.

rows.en: What are you talking about?! You answered right away!
rows.notes: Instant reply undercuts claimed effort.

rows.en: What's this? Are you two having another lovers' quarrel?
rows.notes: Megumi teasing Asuka and Shinji as a couple; lovers' quarrel carries marital joke.

rows.en: Don't even joke about that, Megumi! Who'd ever marry an idiot like him?!
rows.notes: Marriage implication supplied by previous marital-quarrel joke; rhetorical question complete.

rows.en: But they do say the more you fight, the closer you are.
rows.notes: Ayato quotes a proverb to tease the pair.

rows.en: Hey! Don't say such awful things with that innocent smile! I'd never go out with Shinji!
rows.notes: Asuka rebukes Ayato's pleasant appearance versus objectionable teasing, then refuses Shinji.

rows.en: Wow, she's really laying into you.
rows.notes: Koji comments to Shinji on Asuka's verbal attack.

rows.en: Oh, but... I'm used to it by now.
rows.notes: Shinji says he is accustomed to the insults.

rows.en: What did you saaay?! I absolutely refuse to be paired up with the likes of you!!
rows.notes: Asuka rejects being coupled with Shinji; emphasis retained.

rows.en: But you two fought together the other day.
rows.notes: Rei invokes their recent joint combat.

rows.en: Huh?! Th-that was... um...!
rows.notes: Asuka genuinely trails off in flustered explanation.

rows.en: You're awfully flustered. Something's fishy...
rows.notes: Megumi suspects something from Asuka's fluster.

rows.en: What did you two do together?
rows.notes: Akira asks the pair what they did.

rows.en: N-nothing... It was nothing at all, really.
rows.notes: Shinji denies anything noteworthy twice.

rows.en: Hmm...
rows.notes: Teasing drawn-out response.

rows.en: Anyway, where's Dr. Inoue? He said he wanted to see us...
rows.notes: Ayato changes subject to Inoue, whose invitation concerns everyone.

rows.en: Hello, everyone... Sorry to keep you waiting.
rows.notes: Inoue greets group politely.

rows.en: Um... what did you want to see us about?
rows.notes: Ayato asks purpose of invitation.

rows.en: Well, you all regularly pilot super robots... or see them in action. I'd like to hear what you have to say.
rows.notes: Both pilots and observers included; Inoue requests their knowledge.

rows.en: Sure, I don't mind... But what for?
rows.notes: Koji agrees to talk and asks purpose.

rows.en: Actually, it's for Dendoh.
rows.notes: Stray closing wrapper and @ ignored as instructed.

rows.en: In case Dendoh loses its Data Weapons again, like it did the other day...
rows.notes: Conditional setup deliberately trails into103.

rows.en: I thought we should have some sort of backup plan ready.
rows.notes: Main backup-plan proposal completes102.

rows.en: A backup plan... Are you making weapons to take the place of the Data Weapons?
rows.notes: Koji checks whether alternative weapons are intended.

rows.en: Yes, that's right. If possible, I'd also like to raise its attack power above what it has without Data Weapons.
rows.notes: Comparison is to Dendoh without using Data Weapons, not to Data Weapon output.

rows.en: So I thought I'd look to the weapons on various super robots for ideas...
rows.notes: Inoue seeks inspiration from multiple super robots; unfinished source.

rows.en: Then you mean something like Raideen's God Gorgon...
rows.notes: Akira offers weapon example, genuine list fragment.

rows.en: Or an EVA's Pallet Rifle, or a Gundam's Beam Rifle...
rows.notes: Shinji adds two weapon examples to list, genuine fragment.

rows.en: Yes. I'd also like to reinforce its armor.
rows.notes: Inoue adds armor upgrade.

rows.en: I see... So you're giving it the full armor treatment. Like Captain Quattro's Hyaku Shiki.
rows.notes: Source-short Hyaku Shiki not expanded to Kai; Captain rank retained.

rows.en: Full armor... Full Armor Dendoh... That sounds good.
rows.notes: Inoue tests proposed Full Armor Dendoh name aloud.

rows.en: Well then, would you tell me about them right away?
rows.notes: Request direction: Inoue asks group to tell him weapon information.

rows.en: Captain Bright, we have an incoming call from Dr. Kabuto at the Science Fortress Laboratory.
rows.notes: Rose relays Kenzo's call to Bright; full institute name retained.

rows.en: Understood. Put the call through to me.
rows.notes: Bright instructs Rose to connect call.

rows.en: This is Kenzo Kabuto of the Science Fortress Laboratory. I'm sorry to trouble you when you're so busy.
rows.notes: Kenzo introduces himself using full name and apologizes for busy-time interruption.

rows.en: Not at all. Now... what can I do for you?
rows.notes: Bright politely asks purpose.

rows.en: We've finished the new weapon we've been developing for Great Mazinger here.
rows.notes: Kenzo's institute has completed Great Mazinger's new weapon.

rows.en: So... I'd like you to send Tetsuya Tsurugi and Jun Hono here so we can run some tests...
rows.notes: Request direction: Kenzo asks Bright to send both pilots to Kenzo for testing.

rows.en: Understood. I'll let the two of them know.
rows.notes: Bright will notify both named pilots.

rows.en: What...? You say you can't find Masato?
rows.notes: Oki confirms Miku's missing-person report.

rows.en: Y-yes.
rows.notes: Stutter retained; stray wrapper removed.

rows.en: He should have a transmitter with him. There's no reason we shouldn't be able to track his location with it.
rows.notes: Transmitter belongs to Masato (sourced male profile); location subject explicit.

rows.en: Well... I checked the monitoring data, and his signal disappeared just as he reached the base's outer perimeter.
rows.notes: Monitoring data examined by Miku; disappearance at outer perimeter, not proof of escape.

rows.en: Maybe Masato has been...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished speculation completed by Oki125.

rows.en: Are you saying the enemy abducted him?
rows.notes: Oki supplies suspected enemy abduction.

rows.en: Yes. Hau Dragon's Hakkeshu might be able to slip through this base's security network.
rows.notes: Hau Dragon source form preserved distinctly from Tekkoryu; possibility not certainty.
Silence plus shock, not omitted grammatical sentence.

rows.en: Oki, I'm going out to look for Masato.
rows.notes: Miku volunteers to search for Masato.

rows.en: ...Can you locate him?
rows.notes: Oki asks whether she can locate Masato, resolved by130.

rows.en: I can if I can detect his bio-pattern.
rows.notes: Restores I can locate him from prior question; bio-pattern literal pending terminology sourcing.
uncertain: Exact canonical bio-pattern term not in read glossary; source-literal rendering pending root sourcing.

rows.en: ...Then I'm counting on you. I'll also have Zeorymer ready to deploy, just in case.
rows.notes: Request direction: Oki counts on Miku; Oki arranges Zeorymer contingency deployment.

rows.en: Understood. I'll be going, then.
rows.notes: Miku acknowledges and departs.

rows.en: U-ugh...
rows.notes: Groan, not omitted sentence.

rows.en: ...Is this really the one?
rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ???; noun phrase means the sought person, identity not added.

rows.en: There was some data left unerased in the government's computer. Records of the cost of raising this boy.
rows.notes: Hidden speaker explains surviving government data: raising expenses, not general upbringing history.

rows.en: W-who's there...?
rows.notes: Actual thought kind; Masato wonders who is speaking.

rows.en: He's the only child in the Japan district who's been raised under government supervision for the past fifteen years...
rows.notes: Hidden speaker establishes sole child and fifteen-year surveillance upbringing.

rows.en: No...! I-I'm... I'm just Masato Akitsu!
rows.notes: Masato insists ordinary identity; full source name preserved.

rows.en: ! W-where am I...?!
rows.notes: Startled unfinished where-question preserved.

rows.en: Where am I?! Who are you?!
rows.notes: Masato asks location and addressee identity; earlier reused Yuratei silence does not reveal hidden speakers.

rows.en: You are in the presence of Tekkoryu's leader. Restrain yourself.
rows.notes: Shi-Aen demands restraint before organization leader; no added empress title.

rows.en: Tekkoryu?! Its leader?!
rows.notes: Masato repeats organization and leader in shock.

rows.en: Ugh!
rows.notes: Pain exclamation.

rows.en: Mind your insolent tongue!
rows.notes: Shi-Tau rebukes disrespect.

rows.en: ...Stop, Shi-Tau.
rows.notes: Yuratei orders Shi-Tau to stop.

rows.en: Yes...
rows.notes: Obedient acknowledgment, trailing.

rows.en: G-ghh...!
rows.notes: Pain groan.

rows.en: Masato Akitsu... I shall take your life.
rows.notes: Explicit death threat at full source force.
Masato protests threat and asks why.

rows.en: You... killed Taiha, didn't you...?!
rows.notes: Yuratei accuses Masato of killing Taiha.

rows.en: Taiha...?!
rows.notes: Masato does not recognize Taiha's name.

rows.en: One of the Hakkeshu... The man who piloted Lanstar of the Winds.
rows.notes: Male reference explicit in source and glossary; pilot role clarified by immediately following robot recollection.

rows.en: Lanstar of the Winds...?! That was the first Hakke robot I defeated...!
rows.notes: Masato identifies first defeated Hakke robot.

rows.en: That is not your only crime... You are carrying on Masaki Kihara's will...
rows.notes: Posthumous will/intent carried on; not mere robot inheritance.

rows.en: That is the greatest crime of all against us of Tekkoryu!
rows.notes: Yuratei identifies continuity of Masaki's will as supreme crime.

rows.en: Masaki... Kihara...?!
rows.notes: Full name repeated with broken pacing; English given-name order preserved.

rows.en: I see... You appear to know nothing.
rows.notes: Yuratei concludes Masato is ignorant.

rows.en: W-what do you mean...?!
rows.notes: Masato asks explanation; stutter.

rows.en: While our people endured bitter suffering underground... you knew nothing and lived out your days without a care...!
rows.notes: Yuratei condemns carefree ignorance while her people suffered underground; continuation160 not imported.

rows.en: You knew nothing of the sins Masaki Kihara committed...!!
rows.notes: Continues the preceding accusation about Masaki Kihara; second-person subject restored.

rows.en: W-who is that man...!? What does he have to do with me!?
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: You say you wish to know? If you learn the truth, you must die.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: If... knowing that would tell me why you're treating me this way...!
rows.notes: Conditional sentence deliberately continues into row164; stray Japanese closing-wrapper tail ignored.

rows.en: If it would tell me who I am... I want to know!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: ...Very well...
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: We of Tekkoryu were planning to assemble an army of giant robots to conquer the world... That was fifteen years ago now.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.
Silence checked at all five original uses.

rows.en: Each Hakke robot was designed so that only a person with a specific bioelectric current and brainwave pattern could pilot it...
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: And the man named Masaki Kihara, who built Zeorymer for Tekkoryu...
rows.notes: Sentence continues into row169, with Masaki Kihara as subject.

rows.en: registered an unborn fertilized egg, still in a test tube, as its pilot.
rows.notes: Continuation of row168; no repeated subject across the deliberate row boundary. Final lower-case continuation follows the subject supplied in row168.

rows.en: Then he stole Zeorymer and the test tube, blew up the other Hakke robots and our fortress, and fled to parts unknown...!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: I was still a child then, but I was the one who should have been registered as Zeorymer's pilot...
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Th-then...! The fertilized egg Masaki Kihara stole was...!?
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished inference about the stolen fertilized egg.

rows.en: Yes, it was you. Masato Akitsu... you accursed man!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: I was... genetic material... created just to pilot Zeorymer...?
rows.notes: Masato describes himself in stunned genetic-material fragments; no claim that he is merely a single gene.

rows.en: Is that really all I am...!?
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Answer me! Th-then, who... who am I!?
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: You are no one. A mere component of Zeorymer of the Heavens... its pilot.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.
Source punctuation-only reaction retained across all three actual uses.

rows.en: ...I told you, did I not? That knowing the truth would mean your death.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: U-uuugh... ugh...!
rows.notes: Pained vocalization, not lexical prose.

rows.en: Man of cursed blood... die.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Who is there!?
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: ...I've found you, Masato.
rows.notes: Miku is context-settled but hidden speaker label remains ???.

rows.en: Th-that voice!?
rows.notes: Deliberately incomplete recognition of the voice.

rows.en: Who are you!?
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Masato, hurry and run!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Miku!?
rows.notes: Name-only recognition retained.

rows.en: I won't let you!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.
Intentional silence.

rows.en: What!? She took my kick without even flinching!?
rows.notes: She is Miku, settled by the intervening named lines and glossary gender.

rows.en: Is that suit giving her this power!? No, that can't be!
rows.notes: She refers to Miku; Shi-Aen rejects the suit-only explanation.

rows.en: Sister, move aside!
rows.notes: Sister refers to Shi-Aen; relation explicitly in source and glossary.

rows.en: This one...! Is she human!?
rows.notes: She refers to Miku; Shi-Tau questions whether Miku is human.

rows.en: ...Masato, we're getting out of here.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Y-yeah...!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Who are you!?
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Miku Himuro... Zeorymer's pilot!
rows.notes: Source says pilot, so not changed to glossary profile sub-pilot.
Nonverbal shock retained.

rows.en: I'm taking Masato back.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: You're not getting away!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Your Majesty, are you unharmed!?
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Never mind me...! Kill those two at once... and make certain of it! You may even use the Hakke robots!
rows.notes: Yuratei directs immediate certain killing; permission to use Hakke robots preserved.

rows.en: Yes, Your Majesty!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Barendos, you understand, I trust. If these failures continue, even you, the Royal Guard captain, will not escape punishment.
rows.notes: Royal Guard captain is Barendos; threat of punishment retained.

rows.en: You think you can order me around, Gandal? You and I hold equal rank.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: I command the attack on Earth. As long as you are at Skull Moon Base, you will obey my orders too.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Hmph... But I believe the blame for my failure lies with the subordinate you lent me.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Eh...? You mean... could it be...?
rows.notes: Broken hesitant question kept incomplete as source.

rows.en: Blacky! Who else would I mean!?
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: No... but... I was following your orders, Captain Barendos...
rows.notes: Unfinished excuse trailing after Captain Barendos, whose orders Blacky followed.

rows.en: Well, don't worry, Blacky. I have a special trump card up my sleeve.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: One that will wipe out all your blunders so far...
rows.notes: Sentence fragment continues the trump-card description from row210.

rows.en: Th-thank you very much, Captain Barendos!
rows.notes: Honorific dropped; rank preserved as Captain.

rows.en: Well played, Barendos... So deftly shifting the blame for your own mistakes onto Blacky...
rows.notes: Thought kind retained; scheming observation recognizes blame-shifting.

rows.en: We're launching, Blacky. Our target is the Science Fortress Laboratory...!
rows.notes: Attack order addressed to Blacky; full laboratory name sourced.

rows.en: B-but... reports say Great Mazinger has returned there now...
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: There is nothing to fear. I know Great Mazinger's capabilities inside and out...
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: With its fighting power, it cannot defeat my trump card... Heh heh heh...
rows.notes: Its refers to Great Mazinger, a machine, not a guessed person.

rows.en: First, we shall destroy Great Mazinger. Then we shall slaughter Duke Fleed and his comrades...!
rows.notes: Bloodbath threat translated as slaughter, without softening.

rows.en: Very well, Barendos. This is your final battle... Leave the diversionary attacks on the other fronts to me.
rows.notes: Gandal calls it Barendos's final battle and offers diversions elsewhere; does not promise success.

rows.en: Don't slip up, Blacky. We're staking everything on this operation.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Yes! I, Blacky, will fight with every ounce of strength I have!!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... What a simple fool...
rows.notes: Thought kind retained; contempt for gullible Blacky.

rows.en: So that's Great Mazinger's new weapon, the Great Booster...
rows.notes: Source short Great expanded to context-settled Great Mazinger.

rows.en: That's right, Tetsuya. Using it will dramatically increase Great Mazinger's attack power.
rows.notes: Source short Great expanded to Great Mazinger.

rows.en: Now I just have to master the Great Booster... I can't wait to get my hands on it...!
rows.notes: Idiomatic excitement from arms itching for action; subject retained.

rows.en: Director, we have an emergency! An unidentified unit is approaching the Science Fortress Laboratory!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: What...!? How many are there!?
rows.notes: Subject/verb restored for the count question.

rows.en: One unit. We believe it most likely belongs to the Vegan Empire.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: The Mishima district is also under a similar attack, and we've been told #部隊名 has headed there.
rows.notes: Exact squad placeholder retained with 128px runtime expansion. Mishima district follows the centralized source-backed addition read after merge.
uncertain: Mishima district combines source descriptor with officially sourced city spelling; exact licensed MX English compound remains unestablished.

rows.en: Then launch immediately and intercept the enemy. Great Mazinger still needs more time for adjustments.
rows.notes: Kenzo tells Jun to intercept while Great Mazinger remains under adjustment.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
rows.notes: Affirmative reply to Kenzo; sir follows sourced male director.

rows.en: Be careful, Jun. Something's fishy about the enemy sending just one unit.
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: Leave it to me, Tetsuya! Venus A and I will protect the laboratory and Great Mazinger!
rows.notes: Jun promises protection through herself and Venus A.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: All right, you're not getting past me!
rows.notes: Context checked in original Japanese neighbors; speaker, addressee, and action preserved.

rows.en: I'm counting on you, Jun! I'll be out there soon too!
rows.notes: Request direction restored: Tetsuya is counting on Jun.

rows.en: Yes, got it!
rows.notes: Works for initial defense acknowledgement and both later responses to Tetsuya's call to attack.

rows.en: Director, can Great Mazinger still not launch!?
rows.notes: Launch question directed at Kenzo.

rows.en: The main unit needs a little more time for adjustments. Stay calm and finish your preparations to launch.
rows.notes: Kenzo tells Tetsuya to stay calm and finish launch preparations.

rows.en: Y-yes, sir...!
rows.notes: Stammering affirmative reply, not a dropped propositional subject.

rows.en: ...Sister...
rows.notes: Addresses her elder sister; retained emotional address fragment in both event5 uses.
Source-short Tau follows current approved campaign_terms entry derived from Akurasu/main Shi-Tau; both event5 uses examined. Prefilled Shi-Aen speaker unchanged.

rows.en: You said your name was Barendos! I'll show you what Great can really do!!
Damn it, the back! Aim for Great Mazinger's back!
You've got nowhere left to run, Blacky! Prepare to meet your end here!
Don't make me laugh! You're the one who's going to die first!
Thanks for all your usual evil scheming! But now that we're here, it'll all go to waste!
Not a chance! If I wipe you all out, the operation will succeed in the end!
Prepare yourself, Barendos! Today I'll settle this once and for all!
Very well! My own neck is on the line if I keep failing, after all!
You always fight the same way! You attack the moment our forces are spread thin!
It's an obvious strategy if you want to win. Though your arrival won't change the outcome!
So you're the Vegan Empire forces! Your dirty tactics are just like those of the other invaders!
All that matters in battle is winning! Don't lump us in with the defeated Baam or Mycenae!
We're fighting this enemy again!?
rows.notes: Restored we are fighting from the battle encounter context.

rows.en: You never learn, old man! Even after all those beatings, you still won't give up on Earth!
Shut up, you brats! I'll force those insolent mouths of yours shut!
Hah! I'm sick to death of that same tired threat, too!!
We're going in, stupid Shinji!
I know! You don't have to tell me!
Don't get cocky! I can handle the likes of you all by myself!
This is no good...! Even if we can use Twin Lord, at this rate, we'll...
rows.notes: Deliberate thought trails off after the explicit we subject; not completed beyond source.

rows.en: What was that just now!?
No way! We can't do any damage at all!!
rows.notes: Incredulous reaction to ineffective attacks; restored we and damage action. Meaning/tone correction from draft No! to No way!.

rows.en: This is bad! It's absorbing your energy with the light wrapped around its body!
Exactly! Your attacks are useless against Pikadron!

rows.notes: Tetsuya's silent shocked reaction; punctuation-only omission retained.

rows.en: Bwahahaha! Tetsuya Tsurugi, where's all that bravado you had a moment ago!?
Tch, the bastard's getting cocky...! So that light is a powerful shield... It's acting as a barrier!
rows.notes: Light refers to Pikadron energy-absorbing barrier; contempt retained.

rows.en: What do we do, Tetsuya!?
Heh, hehehe...
T-Tetsuya...!?
At a time like this, I bet Koji would say...
rows.notes: Introduces quotation completed by row272; deliberate row-boundary trailing lead-in.

rows.en: ...We just have to smash that damn barrier!
rows.notes: Koji quotation; restored we and smash action, dismissive barrier wording retained.

rows.en: What!?
Director, please get Great Booster ready to launch!
What!? You can't mean to break through that cloak of light with the Booster!?
That's right! It's the only way!
Tetsuya, have you forgotten what I just told you!?
Even if we launch the Booster in its current state, the chances of docking successfully are...
rows.notes: Docking probability sentence deliberately interrupted; low probability stated in event10 row293.

rows.en: But if we keep this up, we'll be destroyed! Please launch Great Booster as soon as possible!
rows.notes: Restored please launch action in final urgent request.

rows.en: But...!
Barendos said he already knew all about our capabilities...!
Then Great's current weapons really might not be enough to beat it!
So that's why you want to use it...!?
rows.notes: It refers to Great Booster, stated in row274.

rows.en: Director, there's no other way! I'll dock with the Booster manually!
...All right. I'll trust your skill. But it'll take some time to launch the Booster.
Please hold out until then.
rows.notes: Request to Tetsuya to survive until the Booster is launched.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Same acknowledgement works for both event9 and event10 orders.

rows.en: Director, can't I launch yet!? Jun's in trouble!
And the other institutes are under attack by the Vegan Empire forces, aren't they!?
We have no choice. You're cleared to launch. But you can't use Great Booster.
Why not, Director!?
Because we haven't finished adjusting the docking system yet.
Even if we launch the Booster in its current state, the chances of a successful docking are next to zero.
I-I understand... I'll try out the Booster next time.
Good. I'll move Great to the launch port at once. You launch the Brain Condor.
rows.notes: Restored Kenzo will move Great and Tetsuya is to launch Brain Condor.

rows.en: Tetsuya!
Sorry to keep you waiting, Jun! Now let's finish it off in one go!!
...It's fallen to pieces. We didn't even need to use the Booster for that.
Hehe, that's true.
Wait, both of you! The enemy is still...!
rows.notes: Warning deliberately trails off before recovery.

rows.en: It's come back to life!?
T-Tetsuya! Look up!!
Up!?
rows.notes: Look-up echo is a deliberate reaction fragment.

rows.en: What!? Another enemy!!
Guaaah!!
T-Tetsuya!!
Damn it, you cowards! Come at me from the front and fight fair!!
Bwahahaha, you fool! Who gives a damn about fighting fair in battle!?
They're... Vegan Empire forces!!
They were the ones who sent those two machines!?
rows.notes: Two machines means initial monster and newly appearing attacker.

rows.en: That's right. And you're the target of this operation, Tetsuya Tsurugi.
What? You're after me...!?
rows.notes: Restored you are after me from Barendos explicit target statement.

rows.en: Yes. I already know all about your Great Mazinger's capabilities.
! Could you be the Vegan Empire's Barendos that Koji told me about...?
Yes, that's me.
Then are you saying you've come to steal Great again?
No, there's no need for that anymore.
rows.notes: That refers to stealing Great, not abandoning the attack.

rows.en: There's no need? What's that supposed to mean...!?
Heh heh heh... Your friends are busy fighting the separate force we sent after them.
rows.notes: Blacky taunts Tetsuya; separate diversionary force prevents allied rescue.

rows.en: Don't waste your time hoping they'll come to your rescue.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Heh... Don't underestimate me, you pointy-headed bastard.
rows.notes: Tetsuya insults Blacky with a pointed-head epithet; full insulting force retained.

rows.en: W-what did you say!?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: We can handle a monster or two all by ourselves! Let's go, Jun!
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... Barendos, our operation is on the verge of success.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Then let's finish him off and make that success certain.
rows.notes: Barendos refers to finishing off Tetsuya, not capturing Great Mazinger.

rows.en: All right, Pikadron! Finish off Tetsuya Tsurugi!!
rows.notes: Source-short Pikadron from the sourced full unit name; source full Tetsuya Tsurugi retained.

rows.en: Stop!!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker label remains ??? despite the following reveal.

rows.en: Grr! Is that...!?
rows.notes: Retained deliberate interrupted recognition; refers to Ryoma arriving.

rows.en: Tetsuya, Jun! Are you all right!?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Ryo, you came to help us!?
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo retained; prefilled Ryoma labels elsewhere unchanged.

rows.en: Yeah! I'm sorry I'm late!
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Is everything all right at the Saotome Institute!?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Yeah! We took care of the guys who attacked it.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: I think the Nahel Argama and the Nadesico will be here to help us soon, too.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: I'd like to say that's a relief... But things won't get any better unless we do something about that glowing monster.
rows.notes: Tetsuya qualifies his relief; obstacle is the glowing monster Pikadron.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Our attacks don't work on it. If we fight it head-on, we'll run out of energy.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: W-what!? Are you serious!?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Y-yes...!
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Is there any way to beat it!?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Yeah, the Great Booster. Sorry to ask, but buy us some time until it can be launched.
rows.notes: Tetsuya asks Getter Team to buy time for Great Booster launch; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Leave it to us, Tetsuya!
rows.notes: Ryoma accepts responsibility on behalf of Getter Team.

rows.en: Ryo, let's go after the Motherburn.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: From what I can see, Pikadron is being controlled remotely from the Motherburn.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: If we can do even a little damage to it, we might make that beast of light falter.
rows.notes: Damage to Motherburn might disrupt Pikadron; possibility retained.

rows.en: All right, I understand!
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Ghh...! Tau, why!?
rows.notes: Tau addressed by source-short name; why-question intentionally has no supplied action.

rows.en: I... don't intend to spend my whole life just supporting you, Sister...!
rows.notes: Tau rejects being only elder sister Aen's support; direct second person and Sister preserve address.

rows.en: T-Tau...!
rows.notes: Retained startled name-only fragment.

rows.en: Did you see that? That's how it's done!
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Asuka, you disconnected your cable, so you have to return to the carrier and reconnect right away!
rows.notes: Asuka disconnected EVA cable; Shinji tells Asuka to return to carrier and reconnect immediately.

rows.en: I know that without you having to spell out every little thing!
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: ...It looks like we can manage both groups of enemies now.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Yes. All units, launch!
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: 1. Great Mazinger is shot down@2. An allied carrier is shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat-condition list; one @ preserved.

rows.en: Hm!? This reading is...
rows.notes: Retained trailing sensor-reading recognition.

rows.en: Tetsuya Tsurugi's friends... No, they're not!
rows.notes: Blacky initially mistakes new arrivals for Tetsuya allies, then corrects himself.

rows.en: ...I never imagined there would be aliens where those two fled...!
rows.notes: Those two are Masato/Miku; aliens are Vegan Empire forces already at their refuge.

rows.en: Tau, this is no time to let them distract you.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: We must find Masato Akitsu and Miku Himuro and eliminate them as quickly as possible...!
rows.notes: Full names and lethal eliminate command retained.

rows.en: ...I know, Sister.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: ...A tiny difference in birth order divides us into the one who gives orders and the one who takes them...
rows.notes: Thought: birth-order hierarchy is Aen giving orders and Tau taking them; us restored.

rows.en: Who on earth decided that?
rows.notes: Thought: refers to birth-order division in prior row.

rows.en: Who decided that a younger sister has to obey her older sister?
rows.notes: Thought: sister relationship explicit and confirmed by sourced profiles.

rows.en: Even the Hakke robots have shown up. This could get a little troublesome.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: But they don't seem to be making any move to attack us...
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: From the looks of it, they're searching for something...
rows.notes: Jun sees enemy searching; something remains unspecified from her viewpoint.

rows.en: Tau, I've picked up a reading.
rows.notes: Aen detects Masato/Miku as next reveal establishes.

rows.en: ...Masato, come this way.
rows.notes: Miku directs Masato toward refuge; imperative action restored.

rows.en: But, Miku... Even if we take refuge in a place like this...!
rows.notes: Retained incomplete objection to fleeing here, answered by Miku reassurance.

rows.en: It's all right. Help will be here soon.
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: H-help...?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Tetsuya, everyone from #部隊名 has come to help us!
rows.notes: Exact runtime squad-name placeholder; all allied squad members arrive.

rows.en: All right, now we can pull through somehow...!
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: Hmph. They've made it here already?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: That's the Motherburn...! So their real target was the Science Fortress Laboratory.

rows.en: It has to be Barendos. He knows all about the Great, after all.
